title: Love double wall!
text: Love double wall!. I ordered three different sizes of these glasses and I have to say I love them.  I am huge fan of double wall as it doesn't sweat.  You can use these glasses with hot or cold drinks and they will stay hotter or colder longer.  I have to admit I have not had this brand before so I was hesitant... I think there can be a big difference in quality... however, these arrived (all three size sets) well packed, completely intact and washed up perfectly in my dishwasher.  I have dropped one... on to a wood laminate floor... did not break. (probably a lucky drop but I was so glad)  Having owned this type of glass for years and years...This particular "style" with the dip in the middle sort of acts like a grip and makes them easier to hold onto... much nicer than my other brand which is a bit more awkward to hold and is narrow at the bottom which makes them less stable.... I do recommend careful use... put a bit of liquid in before adding ice cubes, just to be safe... and do be sure they are banging together in the dishwasher... Having said all of that... I have never (in 15 years) ever had one break with ice cubes, in the dishwasher or on even an occasional drop... but with a different brand.  Hopefully these will stand up just as well.  Having said that, I always update my reviews with any issues or useful info.

product_metadata.title: Ozeri Serafino Double Wall Insulated Beverage and Coffee Glasses, 12-Ounce, Set of 4
features: Set of 4 heat and condensation-resistant borosilicate glasses that each hold 12 oz.
Stronger and more durable than common glass, each glass features a wraparound contour that provides a natural aesthetic grip.
Patented double wall design that suspends drinks within an inner wall, creating an engaging optical effect.
Designed to keep your hands cool with hot drinks, and free of condensation with chilled beverages.
description: Made of durable, heat and condensation-resistant, mouth-blown borosilicate glass of the finest quality, the 12 oz Serafino glasses are among the most popular glasses in the Ozeri Artisan Series of award-winning handcrafted drinkware. Each glass features an elegant double-walled design that suspends beverages within an inner wall for the ultimate insulation, preserving drinks at their ideal temperature. The Serafino's unique double-wall design creates an engaging optical effect, while the wraparound contour provides a natural aesthetic grip. Each glass is made to keep your hands cool even with your hottest drinks, and free of condensation with your chilled beverages. The patented Serafino glasses are great for coffees, cappuccinos, hot or iced teas, cocktails, frozen beverages and much more. Whether it is an occasion for a glass of wine, coffee, or some other beverage, borosilicate glass is completely resistant to acids, and your Ozeri glasses will never lose their original sheen. Each set contains 4 handmade glasses designed for lifetime use. The Serafino glasses are completely microwave and freezer safe..
